expertise-card.$description: The expertise card. Two layouts and three viewports, resolved by packages/ame-tokens/resolver.json, which also holds the slots and their structural declarations. These values are the default resolution: layout=expertise at the base viewport. A context overrides only what it changes.

columns.$description: Track count. A number rather than a grid-template literal, so the count is the design decision and the track shape stays one static.

padding-inline.$description: No inset below sm, because the endorsement quote this matches is sm:px-14 and has none there either. It was {unit.14} at every viewport, which put the two cards' contents on different edges on a phone — the expertise pills 80px from the card edge against the quote's 24px — and spent 112px of a 430px screen on space the card beside it was not spending. The inset returns at sm, where there is width to give it. See viewport/sm.json.

font-weight.$description: 400, so the bold is the portfolio's synthesized stroke rather than a heavier cut, and so it beats the prose `dt { font-weight: 600 }` a term sheet inherits inside DocsBody.

margin-block.$description: Equal space above and below each value.
